test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following groups is India NOT a member of?

options.text: The South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC)
The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN)
The Bay of Bengal Initiative for Multi-Sectoral Technical and Economic Cooperation (BIMSTEC)

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN).**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ASEAN is a political and economic union of 10 member states in Southeast Asia.
 
• It promotes intergovernmental cooperation and facilitates economic, political, military & educational integration between its members.
 
• Member Countries (10): Brunei, Cambodia, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Myanmar, Philippines, Singapore, Thailand & Vietnam.
 
• Headquarters: Jakarta
 
• Secretary-General: Lim Jock Hoi

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **SAARC**

 
 
• South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation (SAARC) is an organization of South Asian nations.
 
• SAARC was established on 8th December 1985 with the signing of the SAARC Charter in Dhaka, Bangladesh.
 
• The founding members of SAARC are Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka.
 
• Afghanistan joined SAARC as its eighth member state in 2007.
 
• The primary goal of SAARC is to promote regional cooperation and development in South Asia.
 
• SAARC covers various sectors including agriculture, rural development, science and technology, culture, health, population activities, and others.
 
• The SAARC Secretariat is located in Kathmandu, Nepal.
 
 
 
• **SCO**
 
 
• **​Members:** The SCO currently has eight member states: China, Russia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan, India, and Pakistan.
 
• **Observers:** There are four observer states: Belarus, Mongolia, Iran, and Afghanistan.
 
• **Dialogue Partners:** There are six dialogue partners: Armenia, Azerbaijan, Nepal, Turkey, Sri Lanka, and Myanmar.
 
• **Formation:** The SCO was founded in 2001 by the leaders of China, Russia, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, and Uzbekistan.
 
 
 
• **BIMSTEC**
 
 
• BIMSTEC was formed on June 6, 1997.
 
• Given below is the list of all members of BIMSTEC:__
 
• Bangladesh
 
• Bhutan
 
• India
 
• Myanmar
 
• Nepal
 
• Sri Lanka
